about: Hand labels for the website's written answers (no AI in the browser), run web-none-base, 4 Nov 2026 (chatcomputer.ai at c240eb7), read from each answer and what opened. Same meaning as scripted-baseline.json: pass = a first-time visitor got a useful, true answer to what they typed. mode: the first failure, from the open coding: needs an AI (honest that only a model could do it, and how to get one); unhandled (the page could answer: a fact about itself, or something it does, but fell to "I can't answer that yet"); misrouted (another question's written answer); lost the follow-up. A note on a pass is a smaller fault seen in it.
